purpose: Provide one end-to-end operational and engineering workflow map for the full FPT Portal V2 system, including the permanent Replace Resource consistency change verified by the owner on 2026-09-23.

authorityRules.precedence: Explicit new owner instruction and fresh live proof remain highest authority. This workflow consolidates the website-wide execution model; the Replace Resource override supersedes conflicting base statements only within its declared scope; all non-conflicting base GCH invariants remain binding.
authorityRules.studentVisibleMutationCompletionChain: admin/source write -> canonical readback -> prepared compile/reconcile -> atomic prepared publication -> prepared readback/parity -> live public API -> representative browser verification

dataStores.STUDENTS_KV: current student/trial credential and profile source where applicable

beforeMutation: classify target surface: live student frontend, public-v2 student API, legacy Admin, or path-scoped compatibility
prove live route and deployment ownership
identify canonical data owner and prepared projection owner
trace write path and read path end to end
load preservation requirements and current GCH stop conditions
define rollback anchor and verification evidence
afterMutation: prepared pointer/version readback and parity verification
live API verification where route is public
representative browser verification for student-facing behaviour
record evidence and update GCH in same coherent change

normalStudent.requiredBehaviour: normal students preserve approved multi-device semantics unless explicitly changed by owner

trialStudent.requiredBehaviour: separate trial contract; do not alter normal-student semantics when repairing trial consumption/rearm logic
trialStudent.verification: Admin state plus actual login/consumption/rearm runtime checks

rules: server authorization owns visibility/access, not UI presentation
Current/Previous/full catalogue and locked previews must preserve approved semantics
subject/year/level display mapping must remain distinct from backend identifiers

lessonReleaseImport.preparedWrite: reconcile and atomically publish affected student access scopes
lessonReleaseImport.completionGate: do not treat canonical release as student-visible completion until prepared readback/parity succeeds
lessonReleaseImport.emailBoundary: parent email remains a separate deliberate action

createStudentLogin.preparedWrite: publish and verify student access projection

trialLoginManager.completionGate: Admin action must be verified against actual trial login runtime and prepared access, not merely Admin UI state

replaceResource.rootCauseClosed: legacy flow could upload/hash-verify a new R2 PDF and update LESSONS_KV while the current prepared lesson in READ_MODELS_KV still referenced the old R2 object; Admin therefore reported success while students downloaded stale content
requiredTransaction: validate signed Admin session and selected resource
write replacement PDF to a new unique R2 object key
read back replacement object and verify SHA-256
guardedly update only the selected canonical LESSONS_KV resource objectKey/r2Key
read back canonical lesson and verify exact old/new reference counts
reconcile the current prepared lesson payload in READ_MODELS_KV so the matching resource points to the new R2 object
publish a new immutable prepared-read-model envelope/version
atomically move the prepared scope pointer to the new version while retaining previous pointer metadata for rollback
read back prepared pointer/version and verify old reference count is zero and new reference count is exactly one
return Admin success only after canonical and prepared verification both pass

failureSemantics.preparedPublicationFailure: Admin operation fails closed with RESOURCE_REPLACE_PROJECTION_FAILED rather than claiming success
failureSemantics.rollback: guarded canonical/prepared restoration where possible; old R2 object retained

deploymentGuards: production deploy verifies RESOURCE_REPLACE_PROJECTION_FAILED marker is present
static CI syntax-checks and verifies admin-resource-replace-consistency.js and production import wiring

closedIncidentEvidence.oneOffRepairDisposition: temporary Y5E2 reconciliation machinery removed after production state was repaired; permanent generic consistency path remains

replaceResource.futureInvariant: A Replace Resource success response is invalid unless the student-consumed prepared lesson points to the verified replacement object. Source-only success must never return success.

resourceOpenAndDelivery.authority: prepared lesson/resource state plus server-issued capability
resourceOpenAndDelivery.rule: resource identity must come from current prepared projection; do not bypass prepared authority with a stale canonical-only assumption

required: Admin tools must not bypass answer protection

online11PlusEnglishPreLessonVr.rule: online Year 4/5 11+ English PRELESSON_ONLY access includes lesson-specific VR PreLesson access where content exists

parentEmail.trigger: manual deliberate action after import/provisioning when required

quizBridgeCompatibility.statusRule: preserve current withdrawal/eligibility/launch constraints recorded by the quiz project authority; Portal changes must not accidentally expose or alter quiz behaviour

sharedWorkerPreservationMatrix.deploymentFailureDefinition: target feature may pass but deployment still fails acceptance if any preserved capability regresses

static: Replace Resource consistency wrapper import/marker checks
production: prove current Worker deployment and bindings
verify required implementation markers in deployed Worker
verify Admin routes reject unauthenticated requests
for student-visible mutations, verify prepared state and live API/browser result

stopConditions: live route owner cannot be proved
canonical and prepared authorities disagree and the correct mutation target cannot be established
proposed shared-worker deploy would remove or overwrite an active capability
student-visible mutation cannot prove prepared parity/readback
rollback anchor is unavailable for a production mutation
owner authorization is required by a higher authority and has not been given
